quarantined.reason: Incorrect square-root premise and insufficient distinction between an effect/PVM and a chosen state-update instrument.
quarantined.witness: Every finite-dimensional positive semidefinite effect has a unique positive semidefinite square root, obtained by spectral calculus. This permits a square-root instrument but does not select the unique physical instrument. A projector effect likewise admits other instruments; the Lueders update is an additional specified convention, and a conditional update requires nonzero outcome probability.
quarantined.source_anchor: Section 2.2, printed page 5, distinguishes POVM outcome probabilities from the stated projective update convention. The stronger incorrect square-root assertion is the QA author's addition, not a quoted source theorem.

quarantined.reason: Dimension-boundary statement omits the trivial-factor case; the displayed Bell partial-transpose description is also ambiguous.
quarantined.witness: On C^1 tensor C^7 every state is a product with the unique state of the one-dimensional factor, hence separable and PPT despite total dimension 7. The 2x2/2x3 boundary must restrict to nontrivial local factors. For Phi+ the partial transpose is one half times the 4x4 swap matrix, with diagonal (1,0,0,1) before scaling, not a full identity diagonal plus off-diagonal entries.
quarantined.source_anchor: PPT sufficiency for 2x2 and 2x3 systems. The 1xn boundary counterexample is explicit elementary reasoning, not a new Lean certificate.

quarantined.reason: Unqualified fixed-unitary impossibility has a one-dimensional counterexample; the claimed Hilbert-Schmidt Cauchy-Schwarz equivalence is not the displayed bound.
quarantined.witness: For a scalar x and any fixed scalar unitary u, abs(tr(xu))=abs(x), which is exactly the trace norm, for every x. The impossibility claim needs a dimension restriction and an argument. Ordinary Hilbert-Schmidt Cauchy-Schwarz gives the product of Frobenius norms, not directly trace norm times operator norm; the diagonal/SVD bound is valid but is a different argument.

quarantined.reason: The contrast with the inner tensor product repeats phi on W instead of using the second representation; field/finite-dimensional character conventions should be explicit.
quarantined.witness: For representations phi on V and psi on W of the same group, the diagonal tensor action is phi(g) tensor psi(g). The answer and conventions instead use phi(g) tensor phi(g), which is not the stated action on V tensor W when the representations/spaces differ. The main external-product theorem can be retained after a precisely stated, independently reviewed repair.
quarantined.source_anchor: Definition 4.2 and surrounding finite-dimensional complex representation conventions.
